terrainDescription.zh: 國土狹長，北部為全球最乾燥的阿塔卡馬沙漠，中東側緊鄰安地斯山脈，南部巴塔哥尼亞則轉為溫帶森林與峽灣地形。
terrainDescription.en: A famously long, narrow country: the Atacama Desert (one of the driest places on Earth) dominates the north, the Andes run along the east, and the south turns into temperate forest and fjords in Patagonia.

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Spanish-style bollards: white reflector on the front, yellow-orange reflector on the back — though not very commonly seen overall

utilityPole.transformerMount: Square concrete poles with indents on both sides are common; wooden poles also fairly common

historicalContext.zh: 智利的道路標誌手冊《Manual de Señalización de Tránsito》同時參考美國 MUTCD 系統與維也納道路標誌公約，是罕見的混合案例；智利也是南美洲唯一內外車道分向線皆採白色（而非黃色）的國家，是相當可靠的辨識線索。
historicalContext.en: Chile's official road-sign manual explicitly draws on both the US MUTCD system and the Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals — a genuine hybrid case, unlike most of its neighbors. Chile is also the only South American country that uses white (not yellow) for both its center and outer road lines — a fairly reliable identifying clue.
